result.stdout:
USAGE:
    reeutils [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    reeutils pack -o output.pak ./mod
    reeutils unpack -g re4r -o output input.pak
    reeutils unpack -l mylist.txt -o output input.pak
    reeutils export -o ch_mes_main_item_caption.msg.22.json 
ch_mes_main_item_caption.msg.22
    reeutils export -o fsm.dot input.fsm.16

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    pack <input>           Creates a .pak file from the given input files       
    unpack <input>         Extracts a .pak file to a directory                  
    export <input>         Exports a file using its handler-specific format     
    import <input>         Imports a file using the destination handler         
    msg <input>            Lists strings in an MSG file                         
    hierarchy <pattern>    Shows the dependency hierarchy for a given pattern   
    class                  Generates a C# class for an RSZ type                 
    inspect <input>        Displays metadata for supported REE file types       
    texture <input>        Convert between RE Engine Texture (.tex) and DDS     
    grep                   Search files in a pak for properties/values matching 
                           a regex                                              
    ls <path>              Lists files and directories in a PAK file            
    find <patterns...>     Finds files in a PAK file matching the given patterns
    tree <path>            Shows the tree or JSON view of a supported REE file  
    mcp                    Runs reeutils as an MCP stdio server

DESCRIPTION:
Convert between RE Engine Texture (.tex) and DDS.

USAGE:
    reeutils texture <input> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    reeutils texture -o output.dds input.tex.28
    reeutils texture -g re4 -o output.tex.36 input.dds

ARGUMENTS:
    <input>    Input file (.tex.* or .dds)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information                                    
    -o, --output     Output file path                                           
    -g, --game       Target Game (e.g. re2, re3, re8, re4) - automatically sets 
                     version                                                    
    -v, --version    Target Header Version (default 36, or same as input if     
                     converting tex->tex)

    [expand_nodes...]    Node paths to fully expand   

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information              
        --pak     Pak file path                        
    -g, --game                                         
        --json    Render JSON instead of a Spectre tree
        --full    Always expand all components
